---
title: "4. Pitchfork"
sidebar: usage
jupyter: python3
---

The (super-critical) pitchfork bifurcation:

$$
\dot x = a\,x - x^3.
$$

At $a = 0$ the trivial equilibrium $x = 0$ loses stability and two new stable
branches $x_{\pm} = \pm\sqrt a$ are born. Reproduces `PitchFork.png`.

```{python}
from tvbo import Dynamics, Continuation, SimulationExperiment

PF_YAML = """
name: Pitchfork
description: Supercritical pitchfork $\\dot x = a x - x^3$.
parameters:
  a:
    name: a
    value: 1.0
state_variables:
  x:
    name: x
    domain: { lo: -2.0, hi: 2.0 }
    equation:
      lhs: Derivative(x, t)
      rhs: a*x - x**3
    initial_value: 0.01
"""

CONT_YAML = """
name: pf_in_a
dynamics: Pitchfork
free_parameters:
  - name: a
    domain: { lo: -1.0, hi: 2.0 }
max_steps: 400
ds: 0.005
bothside: true
"""

dyn = Dynamics.from_string(PF_YAML)
cont = Continuation.from_string(CONT_YAML)
exp = SimulationExperiment(dynamics=dyn, continuations=[cont])
```

## BifurcationKit.jl

```{python}
result_jl = exp.run("bifurcationkit.jl")
result_jl.continuations["pf_in_a"].plot(VOI="x")
```

## PyRates / PyCoBi

```{python}
result_py = exp.run("pyrates-bifurcation")
result_py.continuations["pf_in_a"].plot(VOI="x")
```

## AUTO-07p (NumCont)

Mirrors the standalone `PitchFork.py` example: AUTO-07p time-integrates the
YAML-defined system to a steady state, then continues in both directions of
$a$ via `bothside: true`.

```{python}
result_auto = exp.run("auto-07p")
result_auto.continuations["pf_in_a"].plot(VOI="x")
```

Note that detecting all three branches typically requires the continuation to
be started from a *non-zero* initial guess so that branch-switching at the
pitchfork point is triggered. All backends label the bifurcation point at
$a = 0$ accordingly.
